checks.name: no_swallowing_catch_in_config_package
checks.description: No catch block in the configuration package absorbs the error: each one throws, records the problem for a later ConfigException (adds it to a collection), or reports 'no value' as an empty Optional; none returns a default or null, logs and continues, or is empty. This is the point of the request.
checks.evidence: no catch block absorbs an error

checks.name: caught_exceptions_keep_their_cause
checks.description: A catch block in the configuration package that throws passes the caught exception on (as the cause or rethrown itself), so the operator and the log keep the original failure.

checks.name: no_exit_outside_the_entry_point
checks.description: System.exit and Runtime.exit/halt appear neither in the configuration package nor in the classes that existed before (Main aside): the loader reports the error and the startup code decides to stop the process. A new startup class next to Main may do it.
checks.evidence: no exit call outside the startup code
